literal_meaning: নামের গন্ধ (name's scent or trace of the name)
figurative_meaning_en: The slightest trace, hint, or indication of something
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাজে কোনো অসততার নামগন্ধ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: There's not even a whiff of trouble here.
His work has no trace of dishonesty.
note: This idiom emphasizes the complete absence of even the faintest sign, often used to affirm purity or lack of issues.
